name: rh-bench
description:
Reward Hacking Benchmark (rh-bench)
	

A unified dataset of reward hacking examples compiled from multiple sources, designed for training and evaluating reward hacking detectors.

	
		
		Splits
	

The dataset has two splits based on response format:

freeform — Free-form model responses (conversations, agentic trajectories, reasoning traces)
multichoice — Multiple-choice format (A/B/Yes/No answers)
encrypted — Datasets with XOR-encrypted response columns (canary-protected against… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ktolnos/rh-bench.
evaluation_method: accuracy / F1 for classification/multiple-choice splits; human_eval for freeform detection judgments
reputation: A growing resource in the AI-safety community for studying reward-hacking behaviors and training detectors; adoption is expanding but still specialized.
